Kogentic Plan Review v0.1.0: the first release. Review a coding agent's plan locally in VS Code (and Cursor, Windsurf, VSCodium) before it changes your code.

**What's in it**

- One Plans view for Claude Code plans, Cursor `*.plan.md` plans, Copilot plans saved under `.github/plans/`, and a plain `PLAN.md`.
- A review panel with the rendered plan, Cursor todos and inline comments.
- Approve, Request changes and Reject as local review marks, stored in `.kogentic/reviews/` and tied to the plan's exact text. They aren't sent to the agent; "Copy Review as Markdown" gives you text to paste back.
- A risk checklist (migrations, deletes, dependency and CI changes, secrets, missing tests, vague or long plans) and a warning when two open plans touch the same files.
- An optional approval record in `.kogentic/approvals.jsonl`, and a command to add `.kogentic/` to `.gitignore`.
- An optional "Send to Kogentic" command. It's off by default, has no default URL, keeps the API key in VS Code SecretStorage, never follows redirects and shows the payload before sending.

No account, no telemetry, and no network calls unless you turn the connector on.

Blocking approval gates and team approval workflows are available in the Kogentic platform.

**Install**

v0.1 is distributed only here as a `.vsix`. It is unsigned and not on the VS Code Marketplace or Open VSX. Check `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and optionally run `gh attestation verify kogentic-plan-review-0.1.0.vsix --repo kellyadamtan/kogentic-plan-review`, then run `code --install-extension kogentic-plan-review-0.1.0.vsix`. See the README for the details.
